farmingMethods.pocketBoss: Pocket boss: farm the four pattern pieces (Aban/Abhan, Bhotaar, Chi, Dom) from the listed mobs, combine them in order into a Complete Blueprint Pattern, combine that with a Crystal Filled by the Source (Nano Programming 6x QL), novictalize it with Subdued Flow of Novictum via an Ancient Novictum Refiner (Quantum FT 4.5x QL), then right-click the crystal on an Incarnator whose QL is >= the boss QL. steps.mob: Kyr'Ozch Envoy is the final kill; the symbiant is handed over on completion

steps.note: NODROP (verified in items.ocp: Flags stat carries NoDrop bit 26). The quest hands out one unit line at random - RIGHT-CLICK the symbiant to cycle it to Control. CONFLICT: the TinkerTools/TinkerPocket drop database lists the Ear Beta as a drop from Deranged Xan in The Xan 12-man, and ao-universe's 12-man loot page also shows Ear entries (which on a careful read resolve to Shade Spirits). NODROP does not rule out a boss drop, so both routes may be real - the Arid Rift quest is the one two guide sources agree on, so plan that.

summary: A Bureaucrat fills all 13 implant slots with CONTROL-Unit symbiants. The Crat is one of only two professions that may wear TWO full symbiant lines: the ToWear stat-60 lock in items.ocp puts it in Control {Engineer, Trader, Bureaucrat, Meta-Physicist} AND in Extermination {Bureaucrat, NanoTechnician, Meta-Physicist}. 589 of the 1,462 symbiant templates in the client are wearable by profession 8: 285 Control, 289 Extermination, 1 Bureaucrat-only (Syndicate Brain Symbiant of the Leader, 268276), 2 unlocked one-offs and the 12 unlocked Xan Artillery templates that are a known client-data anomaly. CONTROL is the pick, and the reason is measured, not remembered - see unitChoice. Endgame best-in-slot is the crafted Xan Control-Unit ALPHA in all 13 slots; the top lootable tier is Intelligent ... Control Unit Aban QL300.

unitChoice.why: Measured from items.ocp, not taken from a guide. Taking the highest-QL symbiant this profession can wear in each of the 13 slots and summing the bonuses: the two lines are IDENTICAL on every nano school (Psycho Mod, Sensory Impr, Bio Met, Matter Creation, Matter Met, Time and Space all +275), on Nano Pool (+275), Psychology (+275), Pistol (+275), Comp. Lit. (+275), Treatment (+275), Nano Resist (+275), Max Nano (+1095), Max Health (+1095), Nano Delta (+139), Max NCU (+71) and NP cost (-17). They differ in exactly two places that matter to a Crat: Control gives NANO C. INIT +275 against Extermination's +192, and INTELLIGENCE +139 against +98. Both gaps are the SAME item - the Control Ocular carries Nano C. Init +83 and Intelligence +41 where the Extermination Ocular carries neither.
unitChoice.whatExterminationGivesInstead: Extermination trades that cast speed for defence and a little weapon damage: Projectile Damage Modifier +18 (Left Wrist +11, Right Wrist +7), AddAllOff +15 (Feet), Poison AC +273 (Chest) and Chemical AC +411 (Right Arm), none of which Control has. A Crat whose priority is surviving PvP rather than landing calms faster has a real, defensible case for Extermination; it is not a wrong answer, just a different one.
unitChoice.whyThatMattersForACrat: A Bureaucrat's kit is cast-first: a calm (NanoStrain 147), a root (146) or a Demotivational Speech (238) only helps if it lands before the mob acts, and Nano C. Init is the stat that shortens the cast. That is why the +83 Nano C. Init decides the line.
unitChoice.verification: Control lock verified as ToWear stat 60 EqualTo {3 Engineer, 7 Trader, 8 Bureaucrat, 12 Meta-Physicist}; Extermination lock as {8 Bureaucrat, 11 NanoTechnician, 12 Meta-Physicist}. Both read from items.ocp by tools/mp-symbiant-extractor --prof 8, never from memory (CLASS-PROFILE-PLAYBOOK.md section 9a).

_deviations: THE BUREAUCRAT IS ONE OF ONLY TWO PROFESSIONS THAT MAY WEAR TWO FULL SYMBIANT LINES. The Metaphysicist file picks Control because Control is the caster line an MP is in; the Crat is genuinely in BOTH Control {Engi, Trader, Crat, MP} and Extermination {Crat, NT, MP}, so this file has to make a real choice and show its working. The MP, Doctor, Soldier, Engineer and Shade files never had to.

The line choice comes down to ONE ITEM, not a general philosophy. Summed over the 13 best-per-slot pieces, Control and Extermination are identical on all six nano schools (+275 each), Nano Pool, Psychology, Pistol, Comp. Lit., Treatment, Nano Resist, Max Nano (+1095), Max Health (+1095), Nano Delta, Max NCU and NP cost. The entire difference is the Ocular: Control's carries Nano C. Init +83 and Intelligence +41, Extermination's carries neither, and Extermination instead spreads Projectile Damage Modifier +18, AddAllOff +15, Poison AC +273 and Chemical AC +411 across four other slots.

A BUREAUCRAT-ONLY SYMBIANT EXISTS. 'Syndicate Brain Symbiant of the Leader' (268276, QL180, Head, NODROP) is ToWear-locked to profession 8 alone - no other finished class has a profession-exclusive symbiant in its file. It is a quest reward (final kill Tower Keeper Tagnat at Mourning Calamity Five in The Vortex), one per character, and it is a serious mid-game head piece: +100 to all six nano schools, +100 Nano Init, +100 Nano Resist, +100 Comp. Lit., +500 Max Nano at level 132 / Treatment 901. It sits in outsideLineSymbiants, not in the Control catalog, because it is not part of a unit line.
Unlike the Shade (which wears no symbiants at all and uses Spirits instead - playbook section 9a), the Crat is a completely ordinary symbiant wearer; nothing here needed the Spirit pipeline.

The Crat uses the 'caster' key-bonus set, like the MP and unlike the Soldier's 'weapon' set, but with one addition that matters: PISTOL is on the Control line (+275 summed, +137 on the Right Wrist alone), and Pistol is the Crat's only cheap weapon skill (IP cost 1.6 against 2.8+ for everything else). For the MP that Pistol bonus is incidental; for a Crat it is part of why the line fits.

The 12 unlocked Xan Artillery templates (278908-278919) show up here exactly as they did in the Shade pass - they carry no profession lock at all in items.ocp. They are recorded in otherUsableLines as a client-data omission and are NOT treated as Bureaucrat gear.
